title: CallLint Safe-install discovery manifest
description: The Safe-install acquisition discovery manifest (calllint.discovery.v1, ADR 0056). Served static at /.well-known/calllint.json, it advertises the zero-install acquisition surface: the human Install page URL template, the machine Agent Adoption Contract URL template + its media type, the MCP Resource template, and the closed list of available resources. It is a pure projection of already-public baked facts — no score, no free text, no verdict beyond the shipped labels carried on each page. additionalProperties:false at every level makes it structurally impossible to smuggle a second verdict or a public auto-install flag (ADR 0056 open-decision 2 omits autoInstallEligible).
